provenance.sourceAccessMethod: Complete assigned index.html, sources.md and independent-check.md read locally after package README and VOICE-GUIDE. Batch32 data/Markdown inspected for schema and voice only. No other source run, network research, build or publication.
provenance.originalResearchAccessLimitations: Initial automatic browser-backed discovery did not prove clean prior session state; later stateless/fresh-context captures cannot retroactively cure that limitation. Original independent review verdict ISSUES remains, notwithstanding passing arithmetic.
provenance.independentCheckDisposition: Original independent check verified arithmetic, conduct and four penalty-table mappings. It did not certify exact offered units, the accessory/insurance basket, causal earnings uplift or legislative completeness. Emergency evacuation advice remains unconfirmed as a separately sourced procedure.
provenance.layoutEvidenceLimit: No current build, rendered HTML or browser certification performed by this author. Historic source-run layout observations do not certify the new Markdown.

datePolicy: All retained source access dates are 2026-11-07, including blocked access attempts explicitly identified. Copy editing is not a source refresh. Penalty handbook filename is 2021; still linked at original access date, not an exhaustive later-amendment audit. Future commencement and early-2027 prices remain to recheck.

planningAssumptions.profile: Rahman, 42, Singapore PR in Woodlands, 35 delivery hours/week, early-2027 switch, SGD 1500 all-in ceiling; inputs not independently verified. Chinese translation changes no eligibility.
planningAssumptions.recommendation: Conditional JIMOVE MC shortlist for reduced fatigue, not an earnings promise; retain bicycle if approval, charging, cover or budget gates fail.

budgetRows.status: dated retailer asking price; variant unresolved
published fee per attempt; one successful attempt assumed

planningAssumptions.modelLimits: Chosen sensitivities, not measured wages; incremental vs bicycle costs, not total operating costs. Before CPF/tax, no paid insurance, finance, residual value, bicycle sale, extra hours or monetised comfort. Do not double-count depreciation after battery reserve.

uncertainties: Exact retailer/model/battery generation, orange seal, registration/plate/transfer, compliant weight and actual physical unit remain unverified; a model-family match is not certification.
MC 21Ah headline vs 20.8Ah technical table; S3 11.6Ah vs 10.4Ah; Venom 2 vs 2+ identity; MC Pro generation and missing weight; ECO V3 exact-name mismatch excluded.
Asking prices/range/stock are dated claims, not early-2027 quotations or loaded delivery tests. No daily kilometres, range derating percentage or one-charge full-day promise.
Accessory caps, suitable existing bag, included lights, tax/delivery/registration/inspection scope and a required paid premium could break the capped basket.
foodpanda policy blocked; S$1m indexed snippet unconfirmed and not adopted cover. PAB-specific Partner Cover acceptance/full schedules and AA delivery-endorsed current premium unresolved.
On/off-job, waiting, other-platform cover, excesses, claims deadlines and own-bike loss protection unresolved. Statutory work injury, TPL and PA are not interchangeable.

Penalty source has 2021 filename linked at 2026 access; published maxima not ticket amounts or complete legislative-currentness certification. Future battery rules/blue-seal phase-out require commencement recheck.

No PAB-specific HDB storage page retrieved; agency common-area guidance is not universal indoor ban or corridor permission. Evacuation/995 advice is conservative and unconfirmed as separately sourced procedure.
No causal sustainable hourly earnings uplift established; historical IPS/NUS sample not matched experiment, expense treatment unspecified, no recurring new-joiner incentive.
CPF opt-in, individual taxes, platform task boundaries and mode-switch procedure/cost unknown. FEDA is not actual cost; PR example does not get citizen-only transition support.
Original initial clean-session requirement remains unproven; restricted classification labels for authoritative non-enumerated sources retained. No current browser certification.

audience: Singapore delivery riders considering a legal PAB, including Chinese-speaking riders, using a 42-year-old Singapore PR in Woodlands with a tight cash budget as the unchanged example.
localeReason: English and Chinese serve Singapore delivery riders comparing the same PAB rules, models, charging and insurance decisions. Chinese improves access without changing PR status, platform age requirements or eligibility.
